mentions.name: Grog
mentions.description: A mono-repo build tool positioned as a "grug-brained" alternative to Bazel. Users provide their build commands and interdependencies, and the tool runs everything in parallel while caching as much as possible.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Grog, the “grug-brained” alternative to Bazel. A mono-repo build tool where all you do is provide your build commands and interdependencies and the tool will run everything in parallel while caching as much as possible.
